messages:
alex: Quick thread — thinking about a decision tree for per-org rate enforcement (RPM/TPM vs concurrency caps + burst). Proposed flow:

alex: 1) Short spikes -> allow burst credits (burst window + ephemeral RPM boost)
alex: 2) Sustained high TPS -> enforce RPM/TPM limits + telemetry alerts
alex: 3) High number of simultaneous sessions -> enforce concurrency caps + backpressure

sophia: +1 to ordering. Concurrency must be able to preempt RPM so we don't kill GPUs.
sophia: Also we need clear headers the API returns so callers can fallback gracefully.

raj: Agreed. Suggest adding a preflight /quota endpoint that returns:

raj: ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rw-quota: org=acme;rpm=1200;tpm=15000;concurrency=8;burst=300
x-rw-quota-reset: 1670000000
```

marta: Dashboard asks: can we show 'time-to-recovery' and a 'burst remaining' meter per-org? Tooltip: 'when burst exhausted, rate fallback -> RPM'.
marta: And make it possible to override with a one-off support grant in the Console.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging rollout scheduled 1822223500 — canary 5% orgs, 1h metrics window :rocket:
ops-bot: will emit metrics: quota_allow, quota_reject, quota_fallback, concurrency_drop

alex: Migration plan idea: default low-risk orgs get 24h grace credits; high-usage orgs invited to opt-in; after 2 weeks strict enforcement. Also telemetry hooks for anomalies.

sophia: Also need a sim tool in Console so customers can paste sample traffic and see likely throttles.
sophia: UX note: show 'advice' strings like 'reduce parallel chats' or 'batch requests'.

raj: Implementation note: runtime should pick enforcement based on probe: if tokens/sec trending > RPM*1.2 for > burst_window then switch to TPM/RPM.
raj: We'll also log decision_reason in trace for each rejected request.

marta: Sounds good. Can someone create a PR that wires the quota headers + console meter? I'll take dashboard mockups.

alex: I'll draft the enforcement decision doc and a minimal API contract. Posting a short RFC in #eng-docs later.

marta: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: canary started 1822223500, monitoring dashboards at https://console.redwood.example/org-quota-canary
